I answered from the docs in `AGENTS.md`'s routing table (`docs/flows/add-endpoint.md` and `docs/flows/inventory.md`). I didn't open the code, so the line anchors below come from those docs and are unverified. The recipe's own worked example is "rest at the inn", so this follows it directly.

## Worker (rules live here; the AI only narrates)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` and a cost constant such as `INN_COST`. The docs give no price, so you need to choose one. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Add `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with a `POST /`. It validates the body, calls `getCharacter`, and returns an error if `gold < cost`. Then it calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, which only accepts whitelisted fields). It returns `{ updatedCharacter }`. Optionally add `askDM` narration, `appendHistory` and `saveSession`, and an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts:41-48` | Add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. CORS (`:19-35`) needs no change unless there is a new origin. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` | Only needed if other routes will share the rest logic. Otherwise leave it in the route. |
| `worker/migrations/` | No change. `gold`, `hp` and `max_hp` already exist. |

## Angular frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface that mirrors the Worker response. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` and `.html` | Add a "Rest at inn" button and a handler. The handler calls `rest()`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` so the sheet updates, and pushes a system or narrative entry. It also needs to show the "not enough gold" error. Existing buttons, such as Inventory at `.html:9`, show the pattern. |
| `game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. |

`character-state.service.ts` needs no change, since `setCharacter` already exists.

## Docs to update in the same change
- Update the `.md` beside each changed file, with links at both ends (`docs/AUTHORING.md` §3).
- Add a `code.md` entry for the new `routes/rest.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- Update the `docs/PRD.md` §9 API spec.
- Update the routing table in `AGENTS.md` only if you count this as a new feature area.

## Things to watch
- Do the HP math and the cost check on the Worker only. Don't copy the browser-side logic from `usePotion`, which has the unsaved-HP bug B-05.
- Don't edit migration `0001`.
- Keep the Angular template in its own `.html` file, not inline.
